argv: The ceiling on frames a second
ops.body: The owner's first look (iPhone, Nov 18): "smoother, but the reticle has after images and doesn't glide". One cause found and fixed: the dot rounded to a whole pixel at a half-pixel centre (393 px wide). For the rest the preview says what the phone draws: a readout under Hold (frames drawn and offered a second, the longest wait, the time to draw; `lib/ceremony/meter`, `FrameMeter`), shown only at the preview address or with `meter=1` on a replay's link. It goes with `fps` once the ceiling is chosen.
